{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (only completed orders count as converted)
data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for converted customers only
converted_data = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
converted_data = converted_data[converted_data['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
mean_age_converted"}
